name: agent-ways
description: The Claude Code mods agent-ways ships. `ways manage repair` adds this marketplace and installs from it (ADR-406).

plugins.name: attend
plugins.description: attend's agent-facing driver: dormant by default, one status row while listening, typed send, reply, join and peers tools over the attend CLI.

plugins.name: ways-judge
plugins.description: The relevance gate's Claude Code internal engine: judges the prompt lane's jobs through the session's own model, with no key, over the ways CLI.

plugins.name: ways-theme
plugins.description: Claude Code follows the active agent-ways theme: theme.active exported to the custom theme custom:ways at session start, over the ways CLI.
